description: Version the project `cwd` resolves to: Form.io snapshots its current state under a semver `tag` with a `description`, and the project is then at that version. Ask the user before calling. Export the version with project_export `tag`.

cwd.description: Optional. Directory whose project to use; defaults to the client's workspace root.

description.description: What changed in this version (at most 256 characters)

tag.description: The next semver version, e.g. 1.3.0 (at most 32 characters)

name: project_tag_create
